event_chain.summary: MQTT broker missing topic-level access control exploited with own device token
Live camera, audio and maps from about 7,000 vacuums viewable

summary: Security researcher Sammy Azdoufal found that DJI's Romo robot vacuum cloud MQTT broker lacked topic-level access controls: using the private API token extracted from his own device, any authenticated client could subscribe to wildcard topics and receive plaintext data from about 7,000 other users' devices in 24 countries, including live camera feeds, microphone audio, floor maps and sensor data. DJI's first patch was incomplete and a follow-up fix came on February 10, 2026, with at least two more flaws unfixed as of February 17.
